description: "Use when creating, updating, or providing SQL for Supabase in this repository."
---

# Supabase SQL

- Save every Supabase SQL script in `supabase_migration_sql/`.
- Prefer a date-prefixed filename that describes the migration.
- Make scripts self-contained and suitable for running in the Supabase SQL Editor.
- Do not execute a database migration unless the user explicitly asks.
